name: 20141 · Round Hill, VA
findings: ZIP 20141 (Round Hill) has 21 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 20141 (Round Hill) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
